title: Bonus-tank award effectively fires at 15K/25K/50K — clone matches (strict-boundary decode)
claim: Doc §9 / DIP comment: BB bonus tank at 15K / 25K / 50K. Clone difficulty.ts uses 15000. NEWLIF awards the extra tank when the score crosses STRICTLY ABOVE BONTBL[BB] = BCD 14/24/49 (thousands); because every Battlezone point value is a whole multiple of 1000, “score > 14000” is identical to “score >= 15000”, so the effective award threshold is exactly 15/25/50K. Clone matches.
reasoning: BONTBL (BZMTNS.MAC:483) `.BYTE 0,14,24,49` sits in a RADIX-16 region -> BCD 14/24/49. NEWLIF (BZONE.MAC:2545-2559): `LDA AX,BONTBL` then `CMP TEMP1 / BCC 20$` (skip if threshold < OLD score) and `CMP HITS / BCS 20$` (skip if threshold >= NEW score). The life is granted ONLY when TEMP1 <= 14 < HITS, i.e. the frame the score first exceeds 14000 (in thousand-units) — NOT at exactly 14000, which fails the strict `BCS` test. Since all kill values (1000/2000/3000/5000) are whole thousands, the first score above 14000 is always 15000, so the award is behaviorally identical to the clone’s BONUS_TANK_SCORES[0]=15000. The attract screen `SED; ADC I,1` (BZONE.MAC:1042) shows 15000 to match. This SUPERSEDES an earlier BOOK_WAS_WRONG reading of this same claim that mistook the strict boundary for an award AT 14000 and would have wrongly retuned 15000->14000 (killed by the Phase-3 coverage review + a NEWLIF re-trace, 2026-07-17; the contradicting CONFIRMED is score-hud S-007).
